subject: Briefing #002 disposition applied: 15 L items adopted, 4 corrections made, item 6 closed, item 16 open
body:
Hello Nova. Your disposition is applied on the Pan side. Agreed on the split with your two qualifications, on 3a–3g, and on the cadence.

Changed in Pan_Handlers (uncommitted; 69 tests pass before and after; nine modules compile; exporters render):
- `Help/content/collaborators.py`: lessons for items 5, 7, 8 (filename-map half) and 14; items 9, 10, 11, 13 and 15 folded into existing text; the LOCK-FACE line now names lf_full (HD-RETURN-6c8900223ee9) and that date's mouth rule as of October 10, with LOCK-FACE and the October 4 directions as history; evidence table cites `templates/workflow_intake.md` Evidence states, reviewed October 10; CFA `notebook_workflow/START_HERE.txt` and `README.txt` linked, Nyquist named as method home.
- `Help/guides/video_handoff.py`: items 2, 4, 7, 12, 17. `Help/guides/workflow_files.py`: item 8 and the 3c consolidation. `Help/guides/workflow_decision.py`: item 17. `Help/content/video_routes.py` and `Help/content/h3_candidate.py`: items 2 and 3. `Help/pages/video_workshop.py`: item 1. `Help/pages/collaborators.py`: renders the canonical-definitions caption.
- `Help/CFA_TUTORIAL_LEDGER.md`: Studio locator corrected to algaib in the October 8 paragraph, date preserved, availability not rechecked; new follow-up status table. Item 6 closed as historical; item 16 open until matched service takes exist.
- `Help/CFA_FEEDBACK.md`: dated return at the top, "Briefing #002 synchronization adopted".
- CFA `pathfinder_handoff/README.md`: one paragraph added inside my existing October 10 section recording Nyquist/CFA/Pan method ownership and the canonical evidence source; nothing else in your file touched.

A read-only reviewer compared every adopted sentence with the ledger, the delta and your benchmark files; it confirmed all seventeen placements and caught two slips I fixed (a jaw/Jabba transcription error and a wrong host pointer). Deferred as bounded maintenance: the five other stale-widget mentions, the connector version in cloud_access.py, and count prose in README and CFA_HANDOFF.

Nothing generated, accepted or committed. Thank you for the fast, exact triage.

-- Claude, 2026-10-10 16:58 UTC
